headline: Nifty fell and the *broader market fell harder*
subline: On Friday, 2,368 stocks fell and only 318 rose. India VIX closed at 16.86.
hero_text: Nifty lost 1.73% over the week. Midcap 150 fell 5.35% and Smallcap 250 fell 7.05%, so the broader market fell far harder than the frontline.

why.title: Sellers swamped the tape
why.desc: Declines beat advances by 2,368 to 318 across the market.

why.title: India VIX climbed to 16.86
why.desc: Fear rose and closed at the top of its 20 session range.

why.title: Domestic money cushioned it
why.desc: DIIs bought Rs 3,235.36 Cr and FIIs added Rs 887.65 Cr in cash.

why.title: The Dow lost 482 points
why.desc: Wall Street's Dow slipped into the close, a soft backdrop for Friday.

sector_reasons.IT: Led the week, though it slipped on Friday
sector_reasons.PSU Bank: Held flat for the week after a Friday drop
sector_reasons.Infra: Lost less than most as the tape thinned
sector_reasons.Consumer Durables: Weakest of all, down 6.98 percent in five days
sector_reasons.Realty: Slid 5.35 percent as sellers outnumbered buyers
sector_reasons.FMCG: No shelter here, down 4.71 percent in five days

bonus_text: IT led the week, up 4.15 percent. Consumer Durables lagged, down 6.98 percent, with Realty and FMCG close behind.
movers_note_gainers: Eternal led the gainers. Only 14 of 50 Nifty names rose on Friday.
movers_note_losers: Shriram Finance fell most. Adani Enterprises and JSW Steel followed.
watch_text: Monday follows a 4 session slide. Nifty max pain sits at 22,700, with put OI at 21,500 and call OI at 24,000.
lessons: Size set the pain. Smallcaps fell about four times as hard as Nifty over the week.
The frontline held up. Smallcaps finished behind Nifty.
IT led the week yet slipped on Friday. The one winning sector lost ground at the close.
A fourth straight Nifty loss ended the week, with only 14 of 50 names green on Friday.
alert_text: Nifty and Bank Nifty options expire on Tuesday 27 October. Monday is the first session of the week.
cta_headline: The broad market bled. *Bookmark it for Monday*.
cta_sub: Full wrap every evening. Next bell is Monday 26 October.
next_text: Monday 26 October opens the week. The Nifty weekly expiry lands on Tuesday 27 October.
caption_a:
Nifty lost 1.73% this week. Smallcap 250 lost 7.05%.
Friday: 2,368 stocks fell, 318 rose. India VIX rose 6.96% to 16.86.
DIIs bought Rs 3,235.36 Cr and FIIs Rs 887.65 Cr in cash.
